scores.tell: Duck and green burst are very saturated; sand is fine, but the whole card is at full chroma with little muted rest.
Blue bottle on an orange/yellow burst is a fairly pure complementary pair at equal loudness; shadows stay saturated blue.
Blue/yellow with cyan keys is clean and matches the real cards; the background is a little uniform.
Barrel is a muted brown-orange with a pale yellow background, which reads more naturalistic and less saturated than the real cards. The wood planks are slightly dull.
Many hue families (purple, blue, red, orange, white), and the saturated purple/magenta burst competes with the hero.
Hot-orange flip-flops on a cyan stripe: strong complementary pair with no muted rest. The background is pure cyan.
Natural wagon colors in a green and blue landscape; the background is a little duller than the real cards. The overall palette is believable.
Orange and green with a navy accent, near real cards; the lime stripes are slightly pale.
Orange locker on a purple wall, balanced with muted wood floor and white trim. Blue and green accents are small.
Cyan burst with red and silver rocket is a clean palette; the cyan is slightly pure and the silver is nearly neutral.
